Alex Puthenchira | hq_location = | hq_location_city = [[Bangalore]], [[Karnataka]], [[India]] | area_served = Worldwide | num_locations = 5 ([[India]], [[United States]], [[United Kingdom]], [[Singapore]] and [[United Arab Emirates]]) | key_people = {{unbulleted list|Nisha Dutt (CEO)|Sumit Agarwal (CFO)|Asha Subramanian (CHRO)| Harsha Angeri (Vice President - Corporate Strategy)}} | website = {{URL|https://www.subex.com}} }} '''Subex Limited''' is an Indian [[enterprise software]] company based in [[Bangalore]], which provides digital trust products to [[communication service providers]]. The company is listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] in [[India]]. == History == Subex was founded in 1992 by Subash Menon and Alex Puthenchira as a marketing company; the word "Subex" is a [[portmanteau]] of the founders' first names. The company then started providing enterprise software services like [[revenue assurance]], [[fraud detection]] and network analytics to [[telecommunications service provider|telecom operators]].{{cite news |title=Subex appoints Suresh Chintada as Chief Technology Officer |url=http://www.businessworld.in/article/Subex-appoints-Suresh-Chintada-as-Chief-Technology-Officer/13-10-2020-330949/ |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=BW Businessworld |date=13 October 2020 |language=en}} The company went public in July 1999, and got listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India]].{{cite news |last1=Baburajan |first1=K |title=Subex to go public on July 19; Morgan Stanley to pick up 5% |url=http://expressindia.indianexpress.com/fe/daily/19990701/fma01065.html |accessdate=29 October 2020 |work=Financial Express |publisher=The Indian Express |date=1 July 1999|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190322064856/http://expressindia.indianexpress.com/fe/daily/19990701/fma01065.html |archive-date=2019-03-22 }} In 2006, Subex acquired British firm Azure Solutions for {{USD}}140 million in a merger deal and renamed itself as Subex Azure Limited. The acquisition was then the biggest by an Indian [[information technology|IT]] company. In 2007, the company acquired Syndesis, a Canadian [[Operations support system|operations support software]] company, for {{USD}}164.5 million.{{cite news |last1=Choudhury |first1=Gaurav |title=Subex buys Canada firm for $164 m, aims high |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/india/subex-buys-canada-firm-for-164-m-aims-high/story-m6d0WB5PdkMj0xsnvjFg3O.html |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Hindustan Times |date=18 January 2007 |language=en}} The company's [[Global depository receipt|GDR]] was issued on the [[London Stock Exchange]] in March 2007.{{cite news |title=SUBEX LIMITED SUBX Stock {{!}} London Stock Exchange |url=https://www.londonstockexchange.com/stock/SUBX/subex-limited/company-page |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=www.londonstockexchange.com}} Subex's debt rose during the [[Great Recession]] due to the [[foreign currency convertible bonds]] (FCCBs) issued to fund the acquisitions.{{cite news |last1=Kurup |first1=Rajesh |title=Subex borrowed heavily during bull run |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/subex-borrowed-heavily-during-bull-run/article20509460.ece1 |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Business Line |date=2 October 2012 |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Joseph |first1=Lison |last2=John |first2=Satish |title=Subex charts recovery path after disastrous acquisition |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/opc05iY6PFg6LxQ9NBMX6K/Subex-charts-recovery-path-after-disastrous-acquisition.html |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Livemint |date=26 January 2010 |language=en}} In 2011, Subex sold the provisioning and activation verticals of Syndesis to [[Netcracker Technology]].{{cite news |last1=Philipose |first1=Mobis |title=Subex remains on the edge even after selling activation business |url=https://www.livemint.com/Money/b8anCTMdXKRtKqGLvgFO1H/Subex-remains-on-the-edge-even-after-selling-activation-busi.html |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Livemint |date=20 September 2011 |language=en}} In 2012, Menon resigned from the company,{{cite news |last1=Dharamkumar |first1=Rohin |title=The Rise And Fall Of Subex Founder Subash Menon |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/boardroom/the-rise-and-fall-of-subex-founder-subash-menon/34109/1 |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Forbes India |date=8 November 2012 |language=en}} and Surjeet Singh was named the new CEO and managing director.{{cite news |last1=Kurup |first1=Rajesh |title=Surjeet Singh is Subex new MD, CEO |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/surjeet-singh-is-subex-new-md-ceo/article20510998.ece1 |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Business Line |date=5 October 2012 |language=en}} By 2016, Subex converted the FCCBs and was reported to have become a debt-free company.{{cite news |last1=Mohapatra |first1=Debasis |title=Subex launches CrunchMetrics, forays into fintech, retail and e-commerce |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/subex-launches-crunchmetrics-forays-into-fintech-retail-and-e-commerce-119010901186_1.html |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Business Standard |date=9 January 2019 |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Ganesh |first1=Venkatesh |title=After reducing debt, Subex looks at new business opportunities |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/after-reducing-debt-subex-looks-at-new-business-opportunities/article8646356.ece |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Business Line |date=25 May 2016 |language=en}} In 2018, Vinod Kumar was appointed as the CEO and managing director of Subex.{{cite news |title=Subex appoints Vinod Kumar as CEO |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/subex-appoints-vinod-kumar-as-ceo-118032100677_1.html |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Business Standard |date=21 March 2018}} The company then expanded its business operations to the domains of [[Internet of Things]] (IoT) security, artificial intelligence and digital trust.{{cite news |last1=Ananthraj |first1=Vignesh |title=Digital trust, deep learning, IoT security to drive next phase of growth at Subex |url=https://www.techcircle.in/2020/03/05/digital-trust-deep-learning-iot-security-to-drive-next-phase-of-growth-at-subex-vinod-kumar |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Techcircle |date=5 March 2018}}{{cite news |title=Subex Ltd. |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/subex-14155/information/company-history |accessdate=14 October 2020 |work=Business Standard India}} In April 2021, Subex launched an enterprise [[Cloud computing|cloud]]-native [[Augmented Analytics|augmented analytics]] platform named HyperSense.{{Cite web|author=Staff Writer|date=2021-04-22|title=Subex launches augmented analytics platform HyperSense|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/subex-launches-augmented-analytics-platform-hypersense-11619074185783.html|access-date=2021-12-13|website=mint|language=en}}{{Cite press release|last=Subex|title=Subex Launches HyperSense, an End-to-End Augmented Analytics Platform|url=https://www.prnewswire.com/in/news-releases/subex-launches-hypersense-an-end-to-end-augmented-analytics-platform-836175616.html|access-date=2021-12-13|website=www.prnewswire.com|language=en}}
